↳ Posted by beckyduncar on March 15th, 2009.

Another recording

This tune is also on Laurence Nugent’s CD “Two For Two” (http://bit.ly/d7WGmJ). Amazon lists it as track 14: “Banks of the Suir / Lois Na Banriona (The Fort of the Fairy Queen),” though I have it as track #15 out of 16. It’s a very nice track; “Banks of the Suir” is a beautiful air and beautifully played, and it’s a great lead-in to this tune.

Part TWO of Fort Of The Fairy Queen/Líos na Banriona

There IS a part for a second instrument for this, which makes for a beautiful duet.
Once upon a time, I was handed Parts1 & 2 at a session, but I only ever memorised Part 1. I cannot seem to find tha page with Part 2, which begins much the same as the first, but has a later entry (possibly ends later as well.
Does anyone have the music/abc notation for Part 2?

↳ Posted by Larke on August 10th, 2024.

Eureka!

The Fort of the Fairy Queen, X:5
I managed to chase down the harmony part I was looking for!
Here it is together with the melody.
As a duet, it’s not really suitable for a session, where the tendency is to learn the melody only. It’s a beautiful piece for a playing at the odd occasion, however, where a music stand would not be so out of place for the majority of us who can’t be bothered to memorise the harmony as well. Enjoy!

↳ Posted by Larke on August 21st, 2024.
